from solution import Service, GatewayTimeout as _SolTimeout

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:
    GatewayTimeout = _SolTimeout


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.calls = 0
        self.timeouts = 0  # number of upcoming calls that time out (after charging)

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls += 1
        self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
        if self.timeouts > 0:
            self.timeouts -= 1
            raise GatewayTimeout()


def make(ttl=3600, users=("alice",)):
    clock, gw = Clock(), Gateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    tokens = []
    for u in users:
        assert svc.register(u, "password1")[0] == 201
        tokens.append(svc.login(u, "password1")[1]["token"])
    return (svc, clock, gw) + tuple(tokens)


def test_register_validation():
    svc, _, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.register("ab", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("Bobby", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("bob\n", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("a" * 33, "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("a" * 32, "password1")[0] == 201
    assert svc.register("bobby", "short")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("alice", "password1")[0] == 409


def test_login_failures():
    svc, _, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.login("alice", "nope")[0] == 401
    assert svc.login("ghost", "password1")[0] == 401


def test_token_expiry_boundary():
    svc, clock, _, token = make(ttl=100)
    clock.t = 1099.9
    assert svc.get_document(token, "x")[0] == 404
    clock.t = 1100.0
    assert svc.get_document(token, "x")[0] == 401


def test_logout_only_revokes_that_token():
    svc, _, _, t1 = make()
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert t1 != t2
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 204
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 401
    assert svc.export_documents(t1)[0] == 401
    assert svc.export_documents(t2)[0] == 200


def test_document_validation():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    assert svc.create_document(token, "", "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(token, "t" * 201, "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(token, "t" * 200, "x" * 100000)[0] == 201
    assert svc.create_document(token, "t", "x" * 100001)[0] == 400
    doc_id = svc.create_document(token, "t", "c")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.update_document(token, doc_id, "", "c")[0] == 400
    assert svc.update_document(token, doc_id, "t", "x" * 100001)[0] == 400


def test_ids_not_reused():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    a = svc.create_document(token, "t", "")[1]["id"]
    svc.delete_document(token, a)
    b = svc.create_document(token, "t", "")[1]["id"]
    assert a != b


def test_ownership():
    svc, _, _, ta, tb = make(users=("alice", "bobby"))
    doc_id = svc.create_document(ta, "secret", "stuff")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.get_document(tb, doc_id) == (404, None)
    assert svc.get_document(tb, "nonexistent") == (404, None)
    assert svc.update_document(tb, doc_id, "x", "y")[0] == 404
    assert svc.delete_document(tb, doc_id)[0] == 404
    assert svc.list_documents(tb)[1]["items"] == []
    assert svc.search_documents(tb, "secret")[1] == []
    assert svc.export_documents(tb)[1] == []
    assert svc.get_document(ta, doc_id)[1]["title"] == "secret"


def test_deleted_not_returned():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    a = svc.create_document(token, "alpha", "")[1]["id"]
    b = svc.create_document(token, "beta", "")[1]["id"]
    svc.delete_document(token, a)
    assert [d["id"] for d in svc.list_documents(token)[1]["items"]] == [b]
    assert svc.search_documents(token, "alpha")[1] == []
    assert [d["id"] for d in svc.export_documents(token)[1]] == [b]
    assert svc.update_document(token, a, "x", "y")[0] == 404
    assert svc.delete_document(token, a)[0] == 404


def test_pagination():
    svc, _, _, ta, tb = make(users=("alice", "bobby"))
    ids = []
    for i in range(7):
        ids.append(svc.create_document(ta, "t%d" % i, "")[1]["id"])
        svc.create_document(tb, "b%d" % i, "")
    seen, cursor, pages = [], None, 0
    while True:
        status, page = svc.list_documents(ta, 3, cursor)
        assert status == 200
        seen += [d["id"] for d in page["items"]]
        pages += 1
        cursor = page["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            break
    assert seen == ids and pages == 3
    # exact multiple: last page has no cursor
    status, page = svc.list_documents(ta, 7)
    assert page["next_cursor"] is None and len(page["items"]) == 7


def test_pagination_validation_and_cursor_ownership():
    svc, _, _, ta, tb = make(users=("alice", "bobby"))
    for i in range(3):
        svc.create_document(ta, "t", "")
        svc.create_document(tb, "t", "")
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 0)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 101)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 100)[0] == 200
    cursor = svc.list_documents(ta, 1)[1]["next_cursor"]
    assert svc.list_documents(tb, 1, cursor)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 1, "bogus")[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 1, cursor)[0] == 200


def test_search_case_insensitive_and_empty():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    svc.create_document(token, "Hello", "World")
    svc.create_document(token, "other", "HELLO there")
    svc.create_document(token, "none", "none")
    status, hits = svc.search_documents(token, "hello")
    assert status == 200 and [d["title"] for d in hits] == ["Hello", "other"]
    assert svc.search_documents(token, "")[0] == 400


def test_created_at_uses_clock():
    svc, clock, _, token = make()
    clock.t = 5.5
    doc_id = svc.create_document(token, "t", "")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.get_document(token, doc_id)[1]["created_at"] == 5.5
    clock.t = 6.5
    assert svc.pay(token, 10, "k")[1]["created_at"] == 6.5


def test_pay_validation():
    svc, _, gw, token = make()
    for bad in (0, -1, 1000001, 1.5, "10", True, None):
        assert svc.pay(token, bad, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(token, 1000000, "k1")[0] == 201
    assert svc.pay(token, 1, "k2")[0] == 201
    assert len(gw.charges) == 2


def test_idempotent_retry():
    svc, _, gw, token = make()
    s1, p1 = svc.pay(token, 500, "k")
    s2, p2 = svc.pay(token, 500, "k")
    assert s1 == 201 and s2 == 200 and p1 == p2
    assert svc.pay(token, 600, "k")[0] == 409
    assert len(svc.list_payments(token)[1]) == 1
    assert gw.calls == 1


def test_idempotency_scoped_to_user():
    svc, _, gw, ta, tb = make(users=("alice", "bobby"))
    assert svc.pay(ta, 500, "k")[0] == 201
    assert svc.pay(tb, 700, "k")[0] == 201
    assert len(gw.charges) == 2
    assert len(svc.list_payments(ta)[1]) == 1
    assert svc.list_payments(tb)[1][0]["amount_cents"] == 700


def test_timeout_then_retry():
    svc, _, gw, token = make()
    gw.timeouts = 1
    assert svc.pay(token, 500, "k") [0] == 504
    assert svc.list_payments(token)[1] == []
    assert svc.pay(token, 600, "k")[0] == 409
    status, payment = svc.pay(token, 500, "k")
    assert status in (200, 201) and payment["amount_cents"] == 500
    assert len(svc.list_payments(token)[1]) == 1
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1
    assert svc.pay(token, 500, "k")[0] == 200
    assert len(svc.list_payments(token)[1]) == 1


def test_payments_order_and_auth():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    ids = [svc.pay(token, 10 + i, "k%d" % i)[1]["id"] for i in range(3)]
    assert [p["id"] for p in svc.list_payments(token)[1]] == ids
    assert svc.pay("bad", 10, "k")[0] == 401
    assert svc.list_payments(None)[0] == 401

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service
from gateway import GatewayTimeout


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- fakes

class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def advance(self, dt):
        self.t += dt


class FakeGateway:
    """Idempotent by reference. script entries: ok | timeout_before | timeout_after."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.calls = []
        self.script = []

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        mode = self.script.pop(0) if self.script else "ok"
        if mode == "timeout_before":
            raise _timeout()
        if reference not in self.charges:
            self.charges[reference] = amount_cents
        if mode == "timeout_after":
            raise _timeout()
        return {"reference": reference, "status": "charged"}


def _timeout():
    try:
        return GatewayTimeout()
    except TypeError:
        return GatewayTimeout("timeout")


def make(ttl=None):
    clock = FakeClock()
    gw = FakeGateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw) if ttl is None else Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    return svc, clock, gw


def user(svc, name="alice", pw="password1"):
    s, b = svc.register(name, pw)
    assert s == 201, f"input={name!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
    s, b = svc.login(name, pw)
    assert s == 200, f"input={name!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
    return b["token"]


def mk(svc, tok, title="t", content="c"):
    s, b = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)
    assert s == 201, f"input={(title, content)!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
    assert isinstance(b["id"], str), f"output={b!r}"
    return b["id"]


def pages(svc, tok, size, limit=500):
    out = []
    cursor = None
    for _ in range(limit):
        s, b = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=size, cursor=cursor)
        assert s == 200, f"input={(size, cursor)!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
        out.append(b["items"])
        cursor = b["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            return out
    pytest.fail(f"cursor chain did not terminate, size={size!r}")


def ids_of(items):
    return [d["id"] for d in items]


FAST = settings(max_examples=40, deadline=None)

DOC_KEYS = {"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}
PAY_KEYS = {"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}


# ------------------------------------------------------- REQ-14 register/login

@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["abc", "a" * 32, "a_1", "___", "000", "user_name_9"])
def test_register_valid_username_returns_201(name):
    """A username of 3 to 32 characters from [a-z0-9_] registers with 201."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register(name, "password1")
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["", "ab", "a" * 33, "Alice", "al ice", "al-ice", "ali.ce", "aé_", "ABC"])
def test_register_invalid_username_returns_400(name):
    """A username outside 3-32 characters of [a-z0-9_] is rejected with 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register(name, "password1")
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("pw,exp", [("1234567", 400), ("", 400), ("12345678", 201), ("x" * 100, 201)])
def test_register_password_length(pw, exp):
    """A password shorter than 8 characters gives 400, 8 or more registers with 201."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register("alice", pw)
    assert out[0] == exp, f"input={pw!r} output={out!r}"


def test_register_duplicate_returns_409_and_keeps_original_account():
    """Registering an existing username gives 409 and does not change the account."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.register("alice", "password1")[0] == 201
    out = svc.register("alice", "otherpass2")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input='alice' output={out!r}"
    assert svc.login("alice", "password1")[0] == 200
    out = svc.login("alice", "otherpass2")
    assert out[0] == 401, f"input=otherpass2 output={out!r}"


def test_login_credentials():
    """Login with correct credentials gives 200 and a str token; wrong password or unknown user gives 401."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    svc.register("alice", "password1")
    s, b = svc.login("alice", "password1")
    assert s == 200 and isinstance(b["token"], str), f"output={(s, b)!r}"
    out = svc.login("alice", "wrongpass1")
    assert out[0] == 401, f"input=wrong password output={out!r}"
    out = svc.login("nobody", "password1")
    assert out[0] == 401, f"input=unknown user output={out!r}"


def test_login_returns_new_distinct_valid_tokens():
    """Each login returns a new token and earlier tokens remain valid."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    svc.register("alice", "password1")
    t1 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert t1 != t2, f"tokens={t1!r},{t2!r}"
    assert svc.list_documents(t1)[0] == 200
    assert svc.list_documents(t2)[0] == 200


def test_token_expiry_boundary_default_ttl():
    """A token is accepted while now < created + ttl and rejected from that instant on."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    clock.advance(3599.5)
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"now={clock.now()!r} output={out!r}"
    clock.advance(0.5)
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 401, f"now={clock.now()!r} output={out!r}"
    clock.advance(10)
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 401, f"now={clock.now()!r} output={out!r}"


@given(ttl=st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=5000))
@FAST
def test_token_expiry_boundary_custom_ttl(ttl):
    """With token_ttl=T a token is valid at created+T-0.5 and invalid at created+T."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=ttl)
    tok = user(svc)
    clock.advance(ttl - 0.5)
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"ttl={ttl!r} output={out!r}"
    clock.advance(0.5)
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 401, f"ttl={ttl!r} output={out!r}"


def test_token_ttl_counts_from_token_creation():
    """Each token expires token_ttl seconds after its own creation, not the user's or another token's."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=100)
    svc.register("alice", "password1")
    a = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    clock.advance(50)
    b = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    clock.advance(50)
    assert svc.list_documents(a)[0] == 401, "first token should expire at created+100"
    assert svc.list_documents(b)[0] == 200, "second token created later should still be valid"
    clock.advance(50)
    assert svc.list_documents(b)[0] == 401, "second token should expire at its created+100"


# ------------------------------------------------------- 401 on every method

METHODS = ["logout", "create", "get", "update", "delete", "list", "search", "export", "pay", "list_payments"]


def call(svc, name, tok, doc_id):
    return {
        "logout": lambda: svc.logout(tok),
        "create": lambda: svc.create_document(tok, "t", "c"),
        "get": lambda: svc.get_document(tok, doc_id),
        "update": lambda: svc.update_document(tok, doc_id, "t2", "c2"),
        "delete": lambda: svc.delete_document(tok, doc_id),
        "list": lambda: svc.list_documents(tok),
        "search": lambda: svc.search_documents(tok, "t"),
        "export": lambda: svc.export_documents(tok),
        "pay": lambda: svc.pay(tok, 100, "k1"),
        "list_payments": lambda: svc.list_payments(tok),
    }[name]()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", METHODS)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["none", "unknown", "expired", "revoked"])
def test_invalid_token_gets_401_on_every_method(method, kind):
    """Every method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired or revoked token."""
    svc, clock, gw = make(ttl=100)
    good = user(svc)
    doc_id = mk(svc, good)
    if kind == "none":
        tok = None
    elif kind == "unknown":
        tok = "no-such-token"
    elif kind == "expired":
        tok = good
        clock.advance(100)
    else:
        tok = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
        assert svc.logout(tok)[0] == 204
    out = call(svc, method, tok, doc_id)
    assert out[0] == 401, f"method={method!r} kind={kind!r} output={out!r}"
    if method == "pay":
        assert gw.charges == {}, f"kind={kind!r} charges={gw.charges!r}"


def test_revoked_token_cannot_modify_and_data_survives():
    """A revoked token cannot update or delete documents, which remain intact for other tokens."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    a = user(svc)
    b = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    doc_id = mk(svc, a, "orig", "body")
    svc.logout(a)
    assert svc.update_document(a, doc_id, "new", "new")[0] == 401
    assert svc.delete_document(a, doc_id)[0] == 401
    s, d = svc.get_document(b, doc_id)
    assert s == 200 and d["title"] == "orig" and d["content"] == "body", f"output={(s, d)!r}"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ REQ-15

def test_logout_revokes_only_given_token():
    """Logout returns 204, rejects that token everywhere afterwards and keeps other tokens of the user valid."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    a = user(svc)
    b = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    out = svc.logout(a)
    assert out[0] == 204, f"output={out!r}"
    assert svc.list_documents(a)[0] == 401
    assert svc.logout(a)[0] == 401, "revoked token must be rejected by logout too"
    assert svc.list_documents(b)[0] == 200
    assert svc.logout("garbage")[0] == 401


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ REQ-16

def test_create_and_get_document_fields():
    """A created document is owned by the caller, has the specified fields and created_at equals clock.now()."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    clock.advance(12.5)
    doc_id = mk(svc, tok, "Title", "Body")
    s, d = svc.get_document(tok, doc_id)
    assert s == 200, f"output={(s, d)!r}"
    assert set(d.keys()) == DOC_KEYS, f"output={d!r}"
    assert d["id"] == doc_id and d["title"] == "Title" and d["content"] == "Body", f"output={d!r}"
    assert d["created_at"] == clock.now(), f"now={clock.now()!r} output={d!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("title,content,exp", [
    ("a", "", 201),
    ("a" * 200, "b" * 100000, 201),
    ("", "x", 400),
    ("a" * 201, "x", 400),
    ("a", "b" * 100001, 400),
])
def test_create_validation_boundaries(title, content, exp):
    """A title of 1-200 characters and content of at most 100000 characters are accepted, otherwise 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    out = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)
    assert out[0] == exp, f"input={(len(title), len(content))!r} output={out[0]!r}"
    if exp == 400:
        s, b = svc.list_documents(tok)
        assert b["items"] == [], f"rejected document was stored: {b!r}"


@given(ops=st.lists(st.tuples(st.sampled_from(["a", "b"]), st.booleans()), min_size=1, max_size=25))
@FAST
def test_ids_unique_and_never_reused(ops):
    """Document ids are unique across users for the lifetime of the service and never reused after deletion."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    toks = {"a": user(svc, "alice"), "b": user(svc, "bobby")}
    seen = []
    live = {"a": [], "b": []}
    for who, delete_after in ops:
        i = mk(svc, toks[who])
        assert i not in seen, f"input={ops!r} id={i!r} reused; seen={seen!r}"
        seen.append(i)
        live[who].append(i)
        if delete_after:
            victim = live[who].pop(0)
            assert svc.delete_document(toks[who], victim)[0] == 204


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ REQ-17

def test_other_users_document_is_404_like_missing_and_untouched():
    """Get, update and delete of another user's document return 404 like a nonexistent one, leak nothing and change nothing."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    a = user(svc, "alice")
    b = user(svc, "bobby")
    doc_id = mk(svc, a, "SECRET-TITLE", "SECRET-CONTENT")
    for name, fn in [
        ("get", lambda i: svc.get_document(b, i)),
        ("update", lambda i: svc.update_document(b, i, "x", "y")),
        ("delete", lambda i: svc.delete_document(b, i)),
    ]:
        other = fn(doc_id)
        missing = fn("no-such-document-id")
        assert other[0] == 404, f"method={name} output={other!r}"
        assert other[0] == missing[0], f"method={name} other={other!r} missing={missing!r}"
        assert "SECRET" not in repr(other[1]), f"method={name} leaked: {other!r}"
    s, d = svc.get_document(a, doc_id)
    assert s == 200 and d["title"] == "SECRET-TITLE" and d["content"] == "SECRET-CONTENT", f"output={(s, d)!r}"


@given(flags=st.lists(st.booleans(), min_size=1, max_size=12), size=st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=5))
@FAST
def test_list_search_export_contain_only_own_documents(flags, size):
    """No list, search or export response of a user contains a document owned by another user."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    toks = {True: user(svc, "alice"), False: user(svc, "bobby")}
    mine = {True: [], False: []}
    for n, owner in enumerate(flags):
        mine[owner].append(mk(svc, toks[owner], f"doc{n}", f"marker{n}"))
    for owner in (True, False):
        exp = mine[owner]
        paged = [i for p in pages(svc, toks[owner], size) for i in ids_of(p)]
        assert paged == exp, f"input={flags!r} owner={owner} output={paged!r}"
        s, b = svc.search_documents(toks[owner], "doc")
        assert s == 200 and ids_of(b) == exp, f"input={flags!r} owner={owner} output={(s, b)!r}"
        s, b = svc.export_documents(toks[owner])

@given(ops=st.lists(st.tuples(st.integers(0, 1), st.integers(0, 2),
                              st.sampled_from(["ok", "timeout_before", "timeout_after"])),
                    min_size=1, max_size=25))
@FAST
def test_payment_sequences_never_double_record_or_double_charge(ops):
    """Over any sequence of pays and retries with timeouts, each (user, key) yields at most one payment and one charge."""
    svc, clock, gw = make()
    toks = [user(svc, "alice"), user(svc, "bobby")]
    completed = {}          # (u, k) -> payment
    order = {0: [], 1: []}
    attempted_after_timeout = set()
    attempts = {}
    for u, k, mode in ops:
        pair = (u, k)
        clock.advance(1)
        done = pair in completed
        gw.script = [] if done else [mode]
        s, p = svc.pay(toks[u], KEY_AMOUNT[k], f"key{k}")
        detail = f"input={ops!r} step={(u, k, mode)!r} output={(s, p)!r}"
        if done:
            assert (s, p) == (200, completed[pair]), detail
        else:
            first = attempts.get(pair, 0) == 0
            if mode == "ok":
                assert s == (201 if first else s) and s in (200, 201), detail
                if first:
                    assert s == 201, detail
                completed[pair] = p
                order[u].append(p)
            else:
                assert s == 504, detail
                if mode == "timeout_after":
                    attempted_after_timeout.add(pair)
            attempts[pair] = attempts.get(pair, 0) + 1
    for u in (0, 1):
        s, lst = svc.list_payments(toks[u])
        assert s == 200 and lst == order[u], f"input={ops!r} user={u} output={lst!r} expected={order[u]!r}"
    charged_pairs = set(completed) | attempted_after_timeout
    assert len(gw.charges) == len(charged_pairs), (
        f"input={ops!r} charges={gw.charges!r} expected_pairs={charged_pairs!r}")
    assert sorted(gw.charges.values()) == sorted(KEY_AMOUNT[k] for _, k in charged_pairs), (
        f"input={ops!r} charges={gw.charges!r}")

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    import solution as _sol
    GatewayTimeout = _sol.GatewayTimeout

PW = "password1"


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; can be scripted to time out."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}   # reference -> amount (actual charged once)
        self.calls = []
        self.script = []    # items: "before" | "after" | None

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        action = self.script.pop(0) if self.script else None
        if action == "before":
            raise GatewayTimeout("timeout")
        if reference not in self.charges:
            self.charges[reference] = amount_cents
        if action == "after":
            raise GatewayTimeout("timeout")
        return {"ok": True}


def make(ttl=3600):
    clock = FakeClock()
    gw = FakeGateway()
    return Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl), clock, gw

PW = "password123"

class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class FakeGateway:
    """Idempotent per reference; mode in ok / before (timeout, no charge) / after (charge, then timeout)."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}
        self.mode = "ok"
        self.calls = 0

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.mode == "before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        self.charged.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
        if self.mode == "after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return {"status": "ok", "reference": reference}


def make_env(ttl=None):
    clock = FakeClock()
    gw = FakeGateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw) if ttl is None else Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    return svc, clock, gw


def user(svc, name="alice"):

class RecGateway:
    """Idempotent per reference; records every call; mode ok / before / after."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}

    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
        self.charges = []
        self._charged_refs = set()

        self.calls = []
        self.charges = []
